User Task Scenarios.task_description: Schedule a meeting with the marketing team for next week.
task_steps: Check the availability of all team members.
Propose a few time slots for the meeting.
Send out calendar invites once a time is agreed upon.
User Task Scenarios.expected_outcome: A confirmed meeting scheduled in the calendar with all team members.

User Task Scenarios.task_description: Set up a recurring weekly team sync.
task_steps: Determine the best day and time for the weekly sync.
Create a recurring event in the calendar.
Invite all relevant team members to the event.
User Task Scenarios.expected_outcome: A recurring weekly meeting is set up in the calendar, and all team members are invited.
